what_happened.line: The Planning Board continued the Bright Farms hearing for 361 Mass Ave to October 26 at 6:35 p.m.
The board endorsed an ANR plan for 452 Northfield Road; the vote outcome was not audible in the captions.
Staff will revise the Northfield Road scenic road decision to make the stone wall repair a condition and attach the plan as Exhibit A.
The stormwater bylaw article is on hold until Adam speaks with the MassDEP contact and decides whether to call a special meeting.
The board agreed to recommend that its GIS hours go to Conservation, and to advertise the ANR rule changes for an October 26 hearing.

why_it_matters: The proposed stormwater bylaw would replace the standard special permit fee with a per-acre stormwater fee, which would change what some development applicants pay if Town Meeting adopts it.
Bright Farms neighbors raised shipping hours, noise, lighting and blasting, and those questions stay open while the hearing is continued.
